summary_en: 311,800 shares to be cancelled effective 31 Jul 2026. Shares acquired via open-market purchase between 23 Dec 2025 and 30 Jun 2026. Post-cancellation issued shares: 7,112,768; treasury holding: 81,181 shares.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: ASIRO Inc. announced on 17 Jul 2026 that its board of directors resolved to cancel all treasury shares acquired under a prior board resolution dated 11 Dec 2025. The shares to be cancelled total 311,800 (4.2% of issued shares outstanding pre-cancellation), acquired via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 23 Dec 2025 and 30 Jun 2026. Cancellation is effective 31 Jul 2026. Post-cancellation, issued shares outstanding will be 7,112,768 and remaining treasury holdings will be 81,181 shares.
